dct_description_sm: "Copy for Col. G.H. Biddle 95th Reg N.Y. Vols. or the officer succeeding him, as commandant of the post."

"Copy for Col. G.H. Biddle 95th Reg N.Y. Vols. or the officer succeeding him, as commandant of the post." Oriented with north to the bottom. Pen and ink. Relief shown by hachures. Shows roads, railroads, rivers, houses and names of occupants. Troop placements marked in red. Shows the area from Accakeek Creek along the shore of the Potomac River to Aquia Creek. This item is in the Map Collection of the Library of Virginia; please contact the Library's Archives Research Services department for more information. Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image. April 2002; source unknown, 1968, Map Cataloging Team. Civil War Map Proj. no.: LVA00045. Conservation: restored Dec. 1968; Etherington Conservation Center, April 2002. Digital image available: 16.75 x 19.38 in. Map accession no. 2746 (1968) Previously filed as: 755.232 M6 1861-1865 1862.
